nodes.title: READ THIS FOR MASKING
widgets_values:
Upload your input video then run the workflow first, it will stop at this node and load the first frame of your input video.

To mask the image, right click on the image, then click on Open MaskEditor.

Create your mask to guide the video mask and therefor guide the VACE model into changing the clothing of your subject.

nodes.title: READ FOR LOADERS
widgets_values:
There are two types of loaders: standard and MultiGPU.

To use the MultiGPU loader, right-click the standard loader and select "Bypass" to disable it.

To use the standard loader instead, right-click the MultiGPU loader and select "Bypass" to disable it.
